title: Rosemary Beach "Mr. Sanders" 122 West Kingston Road- Main and Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Mr. Sanders" 122 West Kingston Road- Main and Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located North of 30A- Private pool and courtyard- Close proximity to neighborhood parks and community pools- Fully equipped kitchen- Carriage house- 7 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy an idyllic coastal escape at Mr. Sanders, a luxury 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom property accommodating up to 22 guests between the Main House and Carriage House. Tucked within a quiet section of Rosemary Beach, guests will love enjoying sun-dappled days in the sheltered courtyard beside the private pool and bubbling fountain. This elegant property offers exceptional walkability to the community pools, local shops, and beach access—the nearest walkover is only a 6-minute stroll away!A picturesque setting for warm-weather getaways, the grand Main House was crafted in the colonial style of the Dutch West Indies. Step inside to find a spacious great room with heavy wood beams, dark hardwood floors, and cheerful artwork. Thermador appliances and ample counter space, including a 4-stool breakfast bar and 2-seat island, make meal prep a breeze. The formal dining table seats 8, perfect for stylish dinner parties. The adjacent living area hosts comfortable seating and a 75” Roku TV. Need to mix in a bit of work on the getaway? A desk is tucked into the hall across from the coffee and dry bar. Outside, discover the home’s heart, a beautiful courtyard with a pool, fountain, and patio furnishings—adorned with strung lights and flourishing potted plants to create a luscious tropical haven. When it’s time to retire, retreat to the primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. For convenience, all the home’s bedrooms feature a Roku TV. This level also includes a charming laundry room for refreshing beach towels. On the second floor, another primary bedroom features a king bed, couch, private bathroom, and private balcony. The 2 guest bedrooms include balcony access and feature, respectively, 1 king bed and 2 full beds.The private Carriage House is perfect for families with a full kitchen, 2.5 bathrooms, a guest bedroom with 1 king bed, a loft with 2 twin beds, and an additional sleeping area with 1 queen sleeper sofa and 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.Experience an enchanting Rosemary Beach holiday while staying in Mr. Sanders Main House and Carriage House. On-site parking for 4 vehicles, plus 7 complimentary bikes, makes it easy to explore. The nearest beach access is Walkover I off West Water Street—a 6-minute walk away. Book both properties today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 22):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboOther sleeping arrangement: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living RoomSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR: -Other sleeping arrangement: Two Twin Over Twin Bunks and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Lofted Area: Two Twin Beds*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
